title: Fix 'View Agents' button in Mission Control: change action danger to action secondary
goal: In ui/index.html, the 'View Agents ↗' button at line 143 in the Mission Control screen header uses CSS class 'action danger', which renders it red and implies a destructive action. Change the class to 'action secondary' or 'action ghost' so the button reads as a navigation action, not a destructive one. Verify no other navigation buttons in screen headers use 'action danger' incorrectly.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: The 'View Agents ↗' button in the Mission Control screen actions (data-testid='mission-view-agents') is styled with 'action danger'. This is a navigation-only action that opens the Live Agents screen. Using danger styling misleads operators into thinking clicking it will cancel, delete, or otherwise harm the run.
